title: GOAT – Blueberry
description:
GOAT Blueberry #16 is a strong nicotine pouch (16,4mg/g) with sweet taste of blueberry.

GOAT Blueberry #16 delivers 20 slimmed all white nicotine pouches with a very discreet fit under your lip. Since GOAT is 100% free from tobacco you won’t have to worry about staining your teeth!

CONTENT AND INFORMATION

- Nicotine mg/g: 16,4

- Nicotine mg/pouch: 11,49

- Content: 14g

- Format: Slim

- Portions/Can: 20
